name: Kurokawa Maria
source:
Maria is in her second year at the school and is the head of the mediation committee. She lives by herself since her parents own some big business and have to travel around the world. She is very quick-witted and very good at getting her point across during arguments. She has been in the committee since she was in first year but her hard work and determination saw her being made the chairman this year. She appears to be quite calm but if you anger her then she will get violent – so watch out!

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/06/12/preview-yomehapi-you-make-happy/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
